study: issue 121 near-duplicate study: the frozen protocol

pages.rule: Every page listed in corpus.json is scored. No page carries superseded_by, so none is ineligible.

pairs.rule: Every unordered pair of pages, each pair once, its two page paths in sorted order.

scopes.within-family: the two pages have the same family

labels.rule: A pair's label is its disposition in labels.json pairs or cross_pairs, else unrelated.

B0.definition: wiki_state._tokenise(title + ' ' + paragraph): the issue 54 signal (b) exactly.
B0.title: eval.patterns.duplicates._title (the frontmatter title)

B1.definition: B0 with a text normalisation: text_rules are applied in order to title + ' ' + paragraph before wiki_state._tokenise, each as re.sub(pattern, replacement, text); then every token is dropped that fully matches a token rule (re.fullmatch) or is one of its words.

text_rules.what: a Markdown link or image link keeps its text and loses its target
a bare URL is replaced by a space

token_rules.what: a hexadecimal token of 7 to 40 characters holding at least one digit
a template word: the non-stop-words of page-types.md's fixed template text, lines 130-131
an item label: one letter and one or two digits, or a us, fr-, nfr- or adr- number (owner, 2026-11-23; plan departure 23)

threshold.empty_union: Two pages whose token sets are both empty are never a candidate: the union must be non-empty.

bar.rule: A candidate passes when all three conditions hold.

conditions.what: The frozen labels hold at least 8 true pairs; otherwise the verdict is not testable, never a pass.
The candidate finds at least three quarters of the true pairs, rounded up.
Its false candidates do not outnumber its true candidates across every pair in scope.

selection.rule: Among the candidates that pass, the one with the fewest false candidates wins; a tie goes to B0.

winner_line_rule: report.md holds exactly one winner line. Winner: none goes with the verdicts no candidate clears the bar and not testable.

reporting_splits.per_100_pages: false candidates * 100 / pages, given to two decimals

issue_54_disputed_pair.use: The secondary re-score reads the issue 54 fixture twice, with this pair as recorded and as companion (false); counts only, no verdict.
